assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough substitutes derived by project maintainers from public text and approximate area constraints.
assumptions.impact: All boundary-dependent geometry and metrics must be replaced and recalculated before statutory or precision use.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities and engineering constraints are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, demolition, parking and infrastructure capacity remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: OSM road, rail and water features provide public orientation context only and may be incomplete or generalized.
assumptions.impact: They cannot establish official boundaries, redlines, protection zones or engineering conditions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, landmarks, operating bodies and phasing are design recommendations rather than commitments by public agencies or named organizations.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario requires privacy, safety, accessibility, copyright, community and professional review before deployment.

assumptions.statement: Land-use cells, building footprints, public-space nodes and scenario zones are design representations generated within a provisional corridor, not a survey of all existing parcels or buildings.
assumptions.impact: Counts and coverage ratios measure proposal representation only; they must not be read as existing-condition density or approved construction scale.

assumptions.statement: LAND_USE code 1403 records broad functional envelopes, while PUBLIC_SPACE records only the nine directly designed intervention footprints.
assumptions.impact: Their areas are intentionally not equal and should be reconciled after official parcel and public-realm data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: JZ-AIOS stage gates, scenario passports, public-value gates and sunset reviews are proposed governance protocols, not enacted rules.
assumptions.impact: Responsible authorities, communities and professional reviewers must define thresholds, legal bases and accountable operators before any live test.

assumptions.statement: References to Beijing innovation districts, science cities and regional relay testing describe optional collaboration roles only.
assumptions.impact: No external organization, district or city is represented as committed to participate.

assumptions.statement: Historic narratives, landmark names, AI-generated media and honor displays require source verification, rights clearance, generated-content labeling and an accessible correction channel.
assumptions.impact: Unverified or disputed content must remain unpublished or be withdrawn pending curatorial review.

assumptions.statement: Public sources report that Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park Phase II opened on 2026-08-06, but this submission has not completed a dated post-opening field audit, operator interview or as-built review.
assumptions.impact: The open park is treated as a reported baseline, while continuity, accessibility, facility condition, use patterns and suitable pilot locations remain subject to field verification.

assumptions.statement: The six gateways, scenario nodes, AI service zones and named existing-space opportunities are concept references within provisional geometry; no exact pilot footprint, owner consent or delivery authority is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: All physical and digital pilots remain at G0 and must pass site, ownership, community, professional, approval and restoration checks before location-specific design or deployment.

assumptions.statement: The T-02 G0 contract has completed one deterministic replay of ten fixed, PII-free synthetic cases with ten exact expected-decision matches, all four distinct declared stop events mapped to their exact recovery actions, and ten exact fail-closed controls covering fixture and contract drift, source closure, precedence, and canonical RACI closure. This proves contract logic only; it does not demonstrate a substantive answer, answer correctness, live source freshness, successful real human handoff, model or API interaction, service operation, field evidence, approval, accountable-owner confirmation, independent real retest, G1 completion, or operating non-AI parity.
assumptions.impact: The scene remains at G0. Any G1 application still depends on accountable source and service owners, refreshed sources, an actually available human and non-AI path, approved site/sample/window/effect threshold/version lock, professional review, approvals, and an independent real retester.

assumptions.statement: The key-area evidence matrix joins each provisional key-area feature to conceptual state-station, public-anchor, interface, AI-zone, scenario and acceptance references; these joins are design relationships rather than surveyed spatial or institutional relationships.
assumptions.impact: The matrix improves review traceability but cannot establish an official boundary, exact site, owner consent, approval, field observation, partner commitment or operating result. Replace and re-run the crosswalk when organizer geometry, owner evidence and field records are available.

assumptions.statement: The Round 2 switchyard plans, relationship sections, ground-floor interface sequences, continuous non-AI/accessibility intent lines, staffed handoffs, removable components, four-state changes, public journeys and place-restoration checks are differentiated concept contracts within the three existing provisional key areas. Massing blocks are relational prototypes, not records of existing buildings, and Dazhongsi's four directions are not a station, road or railway-boundary anchor.
assumptions.impact: Exact siting, dimensions, clear widths, slopes, turning and tactile conditions, ownership, fire and railway protection, municipal capacity, quiet-time performance, operator staffing, component removability and restoration acceptance remain unknown until qualified survey, owner/authority confirmation, professional review and field co-testing are supplied. The contracts add no geometry, scene ID, approval, construction decision or operating result.

assumptions.statement: The maintenance-urbanism contract is a bilingual G0 documentation layer over existing scenes and JZ projects. It defines issue, work-order, responsibility, human-hours, existing-facility-first, lifecycle, independent-recheck, repeated-failure, retirement, and ordinary-baseline fields without asserting that any complaint, work order, budget, named worker, hour, repair, recheck, procurement, or effect exists in reality.
assumptions.impact: All reality counters remain 0 or unknown/pending. The five maintenance task families do not create a new scene, project, geometry, approval, maturity change, delivery commitment, or operating claim; only qualified owners and independent reviewers can supply the evidence needed for a future decision.

assumptions.statement: The seven permanent public rights and the non-AI-first service blueprint are proposal-defined non-negotiable design requirements for any future offered service window. They do not establish that a staffed desk, telephone line, accessible route, opening window, operator, complaint queue, group sample, approval, or operating result currently exists at any of the three provisional key areas.
assumptions.impact: Exact service points, operators, hours, staffing and handoff capacity, accessible-route compliance, group denominators and thresholds, complaint/withdrawal/correction performance, and place-recovery results remain unknown pending owner and authority confirmation, qualified survey, consented co-testing, preregistration, accountable operation, and independent retest. This contract adds no geometry, scene ID, maturity upgrade, legal entitlement, site approval, or field PASS.

assumptions.statement: The Round 5 urban-metabolism ledger is a bilingual G0 documentation layer over the twelve existing scenes. Its seven resource fields and whole-system/exit contracts are proposal-defined requirements, not evidence that energy, compute, equipment life, data volume, human minutes, vendor terms, exit cost, environmental benefit, procurement, approval, or operation has been measured or confirmed.
assumptions.impact: All project resource intensities remain unknown because no valid task denominator or field measurement exists. Measured-energy scenes, measured-compute scenes, confirmed equipment-lifecycle scenes, measured-human-minute scenes, confirmed vendors, and real approvals/operations remain 0. Only accountable owners, qualified measurement, binding vendor/procurement evidence, rights review, and independent retest can replace the typed unknowns; no geometry, scene ID, service promise, maturity, or authorization changes.

assumptions.statement: The Round 6 failure-governance register is an append-only G0 design contract over existing JZ-AIOS, existing scenes, the civic timetable, and the key-area evidence matrix. Its failure classes, human role types, four state axes, three-carrier writeback, appeal effects, synthetic storyboard, independent-retest rule, and retirement receipt are not records of a real accident, complaint, correction, recovery, retest, retirement, restart, staffing assignment, or authorization.
assumptions.impact: Real failure events, confirmed stop authorities and accountable operators, public corrections, completed independent retests, retirement receipts, and approved restarts remain 0; stop-to-handoff and ordinary-use-recovery times remain unknown. Any future event must preserve prior evidence, publish only privacy-safe state and correction facts, keep the ordinary/non-AI route, and fail closed if the passport, civic timetable, and evidence matrix disagree. No file check, synthetic replay, PASS, retest, or restoration acceptance authorizes trial, procurement, construction, deployment, maturity advancement, site/professional approval, rights clearance, or a real-world outcome claim.

assumptions.statement: The Round 7 climate-resilience corridor is a bilingual G0 relationship and future-measurement contract over the existing provisional blue-green proposal, ordinary/non-AI rights, manual maintenance, resource exit, and failure writeback. Its Xiaoyue River observation wing, continuous shade/rest intent, stormwater and ecological-maintenance clear zone, manual inspection route, static-versus-assisted prompt comparison, vulnerable-group journey, seasonal triggers, and removable service edge are not an existing-condition survey, built facility, approved activity, staffed service, installed sensor, hydraulic or thermal model, or measured result.
assumptions.impact: Official boundary and exact siting, survey and accessible continuity, microclimate and shade, hydraulic/municipal/ecological conditions, ownership, opening windows, accountable operators and stop authority, professional approvals, source/threshold/event definitions, equipment lifecycle and exit, rights clearance, and group-specific field outcomes remain unknown. Real field measurements, warning events, installed interfaces, confirmed duties, place-restoration receipts, maturity changes, and new scene IDs remain 0. Green ratio, drawing coverage, concept nodes, file checks, and future synthetic results cannot prove thermal comfort, warning accuracy, stormwater performance, accessibility, approval, construction, operation, deployment, rights clearance, or maturity advancement.
